none: PAS CAM-ED8C62: Roman Coin : Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy radiate of Carausius dating to AD286 - AD293 (Reece Period 14). Reverse legend possibly reads [PAX AVG]. Reverse possibly shows Pax standing left holding branch and vertical sceptre. Obverse legend reads [...] CARA[...]. Obverse shows radiate bust right. Die axis is 12 o'clock, diameter is 21.42mm and weight is 3.2g. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for…
